title: aria lancastriensis
intro: Aria lancastriensis, commonly known as Larch tree or Silver Birch, is a deciduous tree species native to Europe and Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Aria lancastriensis include the ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
